objects: physical card with a source-pinned typed ordinary Cycling ability
events: discard the source as a cost
costs: fixed generic, colored, and colorless mana
timing: any priority window in which the owner may activate a nonmana activated ability
choices: ordinary mana-source selection where manual payment is requested
hidden_information: the source remains private until discarded

apnap: ordinary priority and stack ordering apply in multiplayer
